issues.title: Post-primary legacy-mode extraction does not close the modern-comparator or true no-floor gap
issues.evidence: All nine pre-existing modes are disclosed and exhaustively extracted, but no contemporary cross-encoder/listwise reranker and no true no-floor or role-head-plus-floor removal were run. Existing SBERT/TF-IDF modes are component scorers, not modern interaction rerankers.
required_edits: Prospectively freeze a compact add-on comparison family on unchanged documents, candidates, metrics, and budgets.
Include full, BM25, query-only, dense-only, no-local, true no-role/no-role-floor, true no-floor, and one feasible contemporary cross-encoder or listwise reranker.
Freeze snapshots and selection rules; report all planned cells and comparable resource boundaries.
Keep new results separate from canonical v2 and exploratory-v3, or substantially reframe the article as an audit artifact rather than claiming contemporary method placement.

issues.title: Exploratory-v3 points and confidence intervals target different weighting estimands
issues.evidence: Point differences average seed-level claim-macro means, while document CIs average per-document means equally after pooling seeds. Unequal document claim counts make these different estimands. The validator independently recomputes means but not bootstrap intervals.
required_edits: Choose and document either a claim-weighted or equal-document estimand.
For claim-macro F1, resample documents and pool all claims and all five seed rows in each sampled cluster, including duplicate clusters; otherwise recompute points as equal-document means.
Independently recompute interval endpoints and add that check to validation.
Regenerate exploratory tables, JSON/CSV, Figure 4, manifests, and manuscript values while preserving all eight contrasts and the exploratory label.
issues.decision_impact_note: This does not appear able to create a Holm-adjusted positive five-seed claim because the minimum two-sided exact seed-sign-flip p-value remains 0.0625, but the plotted uncertainty is not presently aligned with its point estimate.

issues.title: Figure 7 retains a non-dominated-envelope claim
issues.evidence: The text disclaims a Pareto frontier, but the graphic legend still says 'Non-dominated envelope' while BM25 and comparable end-to-end costs are absent.
required_edits: Remove the envelope line/legend and regenerate hashes, or measure all relevant systems under one comparable resource boundary before retaining it.

issues.title: Proceedings metadata renders redundantly and one month macro is undefined
issues.evidence: Multiple entries render 'In Proceedings of the Proceedings of ...'; BibTeX warns that string name 'jan' is undefined; the NERC program page uses access year 2026 as its displayed year without a verified publication date.
required_edits: Normalize booktitle fields for the MDPI style so 'Proceedings of' appears once.
Use a literal month value such as {January} for the 2015 NERC report.
Unless an update/publication year is verified for the NERC program page, cite it as undated with an access date rather than inventing a publication year.
Rebuild and visually inspect every reference.

issues.title: Framework label density and nonfatal PDF-string warnings remain
issues.evidence: Framework Figures 1-3, especially Figure 3, have small internal labels at page scale. The log has two hyperref math-shift warnings and two underfull implementation-table boxes, but no clipping, undefined citations/references, or overfull boxes.
required_edits: Simplify or enlarge framework labels, make K=3 abstract metadata PDF-string safe, and clean the two underfull table cells where practical.
